items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: friends over a period of years... I used to get letters from him... I almost cried because he had lost his voice... I felt so bad because I wanted to remember him as the days of when we had fun

ctx.x: Because they had their own beds and everything like that, and if I remember correctly, I had some musicians that joined my band out of his band, and they used to tell us about it, man, that Nat would charge the guys $35.00 a month, you know, like an apartment.
